p.uicontrol: Check side view mirror warning light

conbody.p: When Safe Exit Warning is not working properly, the Master warning light () appears on the instrument cluster, along with a warning message that lasts for several seconds. If the function does not work properly, have your vehicle inspected by a professional workshop. Kia recommends visiting an authorized Kia dealer or service partner.

p.uicontrol: Check side view mirror warning light

conbody.p: When the outside rearview mirror warning light is not working properly, the Master warning light () appears on the instrument cluster, along with a warning message that lasts for several seconds.
Have Safe Exit Warning inspected by a professional workshop. Kia recommends visiting an authorized Kia dealer or service partner.
